capabilities: Import RSS, Atom, and Substack feed items as Markdown notes, one folder per feed
Convert article HTML to clean Markdown with headings, tables, code blocks, and footnotes
Preview and select items in a three-state import window before importing
Backfill older Substack archive posts via endless scroll
Download images and podcast/audio/video enclosures into or outside the vault
disambiguation: Not an RSS reader; it imports feed items as notes once and then stays out of the way.
extras: Desktop-only (not available on mobile) and requires Obsidian v1.13.0 or newer. README warns to keep backups and try it on a test vault first; full privacy details are in PRIVACY.md and discussion happens on Discord.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull web feed content into the vault as owned Markdown notes without duplicates or HTML clutter.

relations.evidence: Substack publications are first-class: paste an @handle, a subdomain, a custom domain, or a post URL

summary: Feed importer that pulls articles and podcast episodes from RSS, Atom, and Substack feeds into the vault as deduplicated Markdown notes.
